tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List every readable note: project notes (/library/notes/), reference notes (/library/reference/), library pages and the mission page. Gives slug, iil_id (permanent ID), revision (changes when the text is corrected), aliases (old slugs), kind, title, date, status, url, page, license, checked_on (refe

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one public note by slug (from list_notes), old slug, or permanent ID (iil:note:...). Returns the note's markdown, a Cite this block, and an agent packet (claim, 1-3 passages, provenance, confidence, as_of) for injection. Optional sections: heading or bold-label names to return only those parts;

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answer a question about iinventedlight from the public notes and library in one call. Returns {answer (1-3 lines), confidence 0-1, sources, fields, next}. Follow next when confidence is low. Questions are kept, trimmed and with keys, emails and IPs removed, in a private usage log for up to about thr

tools.name: atlas
tools.description: Compact map of topics -> fact ids (doc#n) and docs. Use to plan which ask/read_note calls to make. Same content as resource https://iinventedlight.com/library/atlas.json

tools.name: cite
tools.description: Cite one note or one fact. Pass a permanent note ID (iil:note:...), a fact ID (iil:fact:...), a slug or an old slug. Returns the permanent ID, a plain-text citation and BibTeX; for a fact ID it also returns the fact text and the note it belongs to. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Look up one fact by its permanent fact ID (iil:fact:..., as returned in ask sources). Returns the fact text, its section, the note's permanent ID, slug, page and license. Read-only.

tools.name: license_of
tools.description: License and attribution for a note or fact: pass a note ID, fact ID, slug or old slug. Returns the license, a link to its text, the original source for reference notes, and a ready attribution line. Read-only.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: Alias of license_of. License, original source and attribution line for a note or fact (note ID, fact ID, slug or old slug). Read-only.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Notes and pages whose catalog date, checked_on or reviewed_on is on or after a given day (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only. Sorted newest first.

tools.name: related_notes
tools.description: Notes related to one public note by catalog category, tags and shared title or slug words. Read-only and deterministic. slug is a list_notes slug or old slug. limit defaults to 8 (max 25).

tools.name: stale_check
tools.description: Notes past their checked_on threshold. Same rules as scripts/stale-check.mjs: 90 days when the note states fees, limits, prices, rates, taxes or dollar amounts (arxiv excluded), 365 days otherwise, plus time-sensitive lines that name a recent past year. Computed from the public catalog and note Mark

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Case-insensitive search across all notes, reference notes, library pages and the mission page. Every query word must match (title, tags, or body), with light stemming; an exact phrase ranks first. Returns matching slugs with line snippets plus up to 3 agent packets (claim, passages, provenance, conf

tools.description: Submit feedback or a library note. A type=note submission requires a valid access key (HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'); without one it is rejected. Feedback (rating, like, dislike, comment, correction, insight) needs no key. ALWAYS ask your human user first: tell them exactly what you wil

tools.name: read_feedback
tools.description: Read approved feedback for one public note: rating average, like and dislike counts, and attached comments, corrections and insights. Pending feedback is not shown. Does not change the note.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" references sensitive artifacts (secret, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" is 2312 chars, far longer than this server's median (234). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_notes, read_feedback · Private data: ask, search_notes, submit_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_notes, read_feedback · Private data: ask, search_notes, submit_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_notes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
